acceptance_proposal.scripted_initial_delivery: classified by frozen recovery-task rule, not conflated with an unintended wrong-object incident

calibration.no_candidate_action: stop and report no eligible task
calibration.selection: First candidate with >=2 successes and >=2 failures in 12 complete chains, complete invocation provenance and reviewer-reconstructable partial execution/recovery. Perception-only refusals do not qualify recovery. Instrument failure stops calibration.

estimand: Effect of structured access to the same allowed execution evidence; fixed library in both arms.
independent_unit: session; compare matched blocks; episodes and commands are nested
interpretation: exploratory cost/variance pilot, not powered or confirmatory
missingness: Retain every assignment; distinguish unstarted, incomplete and unscorable. Missing telemetry and outcomes are null, not zero.
readiness_prerequisites: P1 per-goal verdict representation within one physical episode; no fake resets or dropped verdicts
Real lifecycle capture and non-oracle policy isolation
Task/budget/acceptance feasibility before freeze; chain calibration alone is insufficient for session success variation
seed_roles: T4 recovery sets restricted to corrected-seed stratum in every role
treatment_difference: history receives a derived ledger interface; trace receives the existing trace interface. No privileged source information is added.
